description: Get the newest individual salary submissions for a job family, optionally narrowed to one location and/or one company. Each row has the company, title, level, location, years of experience, base salary and total compensation. Every amount is in USD; originalCurrency is only the currency the salary was submitted in. Returns { total, rows }; total counts matches up to 250, and only the newest rows are returned. Free limit: The 3 newest submissions, with base salary and total compensation only. No text search, level, years-of-experience, sort or paging. Pass canonical slugs (jobFamilySlug, locationSlug(s), countrySlug, companySlug(s)): resolve names first with search-job-families, search-locations and search-companies; never guess a slug. REQUIRED arguments: jobFamilySlug.

companySlug.description: A company slug, e.g. "google". Resolve it with search-companies first.

jobFamilySlug.description: A Levels.fyi job family slug, e.g. "software-engineer", "product-manager", "data-scientist".

locationSlug.description: One location slug (city, metro, state, country or region), e.g. "san-francisco-bay-area". Resolve it with search-locations first.

name: search-raw-data-points
